cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Basically Finished
cards.instruction: Describe incomplete, late, or improvised work as a thoughtful version of completion.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Here's the finished budget report. Just the title page: I've left room for contributions. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The board meets in ten minutes. They need your figures.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. It's the discussion edition. They can supply their figures directly, without reading mine first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The chair wants a recommendation, not a discussion.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll add 'Approve' beneath the title. Finished decision edition. We've eliminated the discussion entirely.

mechanism: A leads a budget handover by presenting an empty document as intentionally complete, revising its supposed edition to match the chair demands B relays.
confusable: Unlike simply lying that work is done, missing content becomes a positive design; authority depends on accommodating the real recipient through B.
comparison: Meeting deadline and decision wording differ from physical cupboard support and a customer tool handoff.
seedUse: Use canonical D41-b title-only report/discussion/approve progression plus S02-b adapting the form to secure cooperation.
